explication: Nuclei Templates is a community-curated collection of security scanning templates consumed by the separate Nuclei engine. The principal workflow is an operator starting a scan, the engine loading relevant templates, testing a target, and reporting findings. The directory tree documents broad template families and workflow templates; the sampled JavaScript payload shows an auxiliary payload, but does not establish internal runtime wiring. Relationships below reflect the README’s stated engine role, not inspected engine implementation.
